flows.title: Create a group
steps: In the chat list, click the round pencil icon, then New Group. Telegram's FAQ gives this as the Android route, and the web client's chat list has the same button.

flows.title: Create a chat folder
steps: Go to Settings, then Chat Folders. This works in any Telegram app.
Pick the chats to include, and give the folder a name.

flows.title: Share a chat folder
steps: Long press the folder name in the chat list and select Share, or open the folder in Settings, then Chat Folders.
Choose which of the folder's chats the invite link makes available, then share the link.
